ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vitacairn uses the camera to scan barcodes and take photos of your meals.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Vitacairn accesses your photos to analyze a meal from your photo library.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Vitacairn uses the microphone so you can dictate what you ate.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Vitacairn reads your burned calories (Apple Watch / Health app) to calculate your net calorie goal.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Vitacairn does not write any data to the Health app.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Your advertising identifier is used to show more relevant ads and to fund the free version of Vitacairn.
